nodes.label: Foretias
nodes.description: Free, Open-source Resilient Time Integrity Attestation Service. Decentralized time-integrity attestation service that cryptographically proves a message existed at a specific tick in a specific calendar.

nodes.label: Chronomatter (Chronos fidelius authenticus)
nodes.description: Autonomous ticking, stamping, verification component. Owns keypair generation, signing, and verification. Each tick has its own Ed25519 keypair; previous private key is disabled when tick advances.

nodes.label: Calendar (Chronos fidelius grapha)
nodes.description: Calendar data, persistence, mutual attestation scheduling component.

nodes.label: Communerd (Chronos fidelius locutus)
nodes.description: All P2P communication component — DHT, gossipsub, peer discovery. Only Communerd communicates with extra-family peers.

nodes.label: TimeFamilyServer (Chronos fidelius adunatrix)
nodes.description: Orchestrator holding Arc<Chronomatter>, Arc<Calendar>, and Option<Arc<Communerd>>, exposing JSON-RPC and HTTP endpoints for stamp, verify, and calendar queries.

nodes.label: Foretis
nodes.description: Cryptographically signed attestation containing message hash, tick number, signature, and the server's unique TBID. Self-contained JSON object.

nodes.label: Tick
nodes.description: Discrete time unit in the Foretias calendar. Each tick has its own Ed25519 keypair. A Foretis stamped at tick n cannot be forged from the past.

nodes.label: Chronon
nodes.description: Time period between ticks, configurable in nanoseconds (default 60s). Controls daemon tick frequency.

nodes.label: TBID (Time-Being ID)
nodes.description: Unique identifier derived from a TimeBeing's public key. Used to identify the server that issued a Foretis stamp.

nodes.label: TBN (Time-Being Name)
nodes.description: Human-readable identifier prefixed with 'tf-' followed by the TBID hex string.

nodes.label: Ed25519
nodes.description: Elliptic curve digital signature scheme via libsodium. Used for per-tick keypairs, stamp signatures, and identity generation.

nodes.label: Noise_XX Protocol
nodes.description: Encrypted handshake protocol for PtP connections between Foretias nodes. Used for stamp/verify RPC over direct TCP.

nodes.label: libp2p
nodes.description: Networking layer for P2P communication. Provides DHT (Kademlia), GossipSub, identify, ping, and request_response protocols with Noise encryption.

nodes.label: Kademlia DHT
nodes.description: Distributed Hash Table for peer discovery with private namespace isolation. Used for auto-discovering peers in the P2P network.

nodes.label: Mutual Attestation
nodes.description: Cross-signing process where peers verify each other's calendar entries. A stamp from one peer becomes verifiable from another through calendar cross-referencing.

nodes.label: External Attestation
nodes.description: Attestation from a peer stored in TickRecord.external_attestations. Verified before storage; unverified attestations are never appended to the calendar.

nodes.label: C11 Core
nodes.description: Verified cryptographic primitives in C11: Ed25519 (libsodium), P-256, SHA-256, BLAKE3, Noise protocol, Merkle trees, FROST, nullifier, RNG mixing, memzero. Builds static lib foretias_core.

nodes.label: foretias-core (core-engine)
nodes.description: Rust crate providing safe wrappers over C11 FFI via bindgen. Contains CryptoServer trait, domain types (tick, foretis, calendar), Chronomatter logic, config, collision, epoch, probity modules.

nodes.label: foretias-node
nodes.description: Rust crate for server and CLI binary. Contains TimeFamilyServer, Communerd (libp2p), calendar store, metrics, probity. Binary entry: serve, stamp, verify, prove-verification, inspect-attestations.

nodes.label: foretias-python
nodes.description: Rust crate for PyO3 Python bindings. Produces foretias-p2p pip package via maturin. Exposes PyForetis, PyTickRecord, PyCalendar, PyTimeFamilyServer, PyCryptoServer.

nodes.label: foretias-java
nodes.description: Rust crate for JNI bindings for Java. Maven package org.foretias:foretias-java:0.2.0.

nodes.label: Python Shim (foretias)
nodes.description: Thin Python re-export layer. CLI entry 'foretis' delegates to Rust via PyO3. Contains cli.py, thin_client.py, _version.py.

nodes.label: CryptoServer Trait
nodes.description: Rust trait abstracting cryptographic operations. SoftwareCryptoServer is the current backend. Keys are in-memory only with zeroize on drop.

nodes.label: PrivKeyHandle
nodes.description: C11 core handle for private keys. Provides zeroize on drop to prevent private-key exfiltration. Tick keypairs regenerated every tick.

nodes.label: DhtPeerSource
nodes.description: DHT-backed peer discovery component. Arc<RwLock<HashMap<PeerId, PeerAddr>>>. MAX_PEERS cap of 256 to prevent DHT eclipse attacks.

nodes.label: EncryptedJsonlCalendarStore
nodes.description: Encrypted calendar persistence format with per-block AEAD authentication tag (ChaCha20-Poly1305). Replaces plaintext JSON format in v0.5.

nodes.label: PeerPool
nodes.description: Manages peer connections and liveness pings. start_liveness_pings() detects dead peers. Daemon tick advances on timer, not peer responses.

nodes.label: JSON-RPC Handlers
nodes.description: Inbound request handlers for stamp, verify, calendar queries. Mitigations: MAX_CONTENT_BYTES (1GB), MAX_CALENDAR_SLICE_COUNT (10000), echo field for replay protection.

nodes.label: start_local_peers.py
nodes.description: Interactive Python peer manager script. Spawns N foretias servers with unique identities, RPC ports, and calendars. Provides REPL for status, stamp, verify, kill commands.

nodes.label: Custom Base64 Display Encoding
nodes.description: Display-only base64 encoding using alphabet [a-zA-Z0-9|_] for JSON output. 64 unique characters, no padding. Internal wire format and storage remain unchanged.

nodes.label: libsodium
nodes.description: C library providing Ed25519 signatures, hashing, and AEAD primitives. Linked by C11 core.

nodes.label: liboqs
nodes.description: Open Quantum Safe library providing post-quantum cryptography: Kyber (KEM), Dilithium (signatures). Integrated via core-engine build.rs.

nodes.label: PyO3
nodes.description: Rust-to-Python binding framework. Used by foretias-python crate to expose Rust functionality to Python via foretias-p2p package.

nodes.label: maturin
nodes.description: Build tool for Rust-Python packages. Produces foretias-p2p pip wheel from foretias-python crate.

nodes.label: bindgen
nodes.description: Rust FFI binding generator. Core-engine build.rs runs bindgen over foretias_core.h to generate Rust bindings for C11 core.

nodes.label: CI Pipeline
nodes.description: GitHub Actions workflow on alpha/mvp branches. Four jobs: c11-tests, rust-tests (needs c11-tests), python-tests (needs rust-tests), lint (parallel). C11 build cached across jobs.

nodes.label: Release Pipeline
nodes.description: GitHub Actions workflow triggered on v* tags. Builds Python package with hatch, checks with twine, publishes to PyPI via trusted publisher or API token.

nodes.label: Network Observer
nodes.description: Attacker with passive read access to all TCP traffic. High impact on JSON-RPC content confidentiality. libp2p transport is encrypted via Noise, so P2P control plane is opaque.

nodes.label: Active Network Attacker
nodes.description: Attacker with full MITM on TCP. Can inject, drop, modify, replay packets. Cannot break libp2p Noise handshake or forge Ed25519 signatures. Medium impact.

nodes.label: Compromised Peer
nodes.description: Legitimate peer with valid keys behaving maliciously. Can send forged requests, refuse to attest, or collude. Medium-high impact. Cross-signature verification limits single-peer damage.

nodes.label: Content Replay Attack
nodes.description: Attacker captures /stamp JSON-RPC response and replays with different content. Mitigated by echo field encoding requester identity + tick number.

nodes.label: Stamp Flood (DoS)
nodes.description: High volume of stamp requests to exhaust CPU or job queue. Mitigated by two-layer rate limit, MAX_JOB_QUEUE_DEPTH=64, timer-driven tick advance.

nodes.label: DHT Eclipse Attack
nodes.description: Attacker controls majority of a node's Kademlia peer table, isolating from honest peers. Mitigated by private namespace key, bootstrap list, MAX_PEERS cap.

nodes.label: Sybil via RNG Failure
nodes.description: Weak or predictable RNG produces colliding TBIDs. Mitigated by rng_mix.c multi-source entropy mixing. v0.7 adds explicit collision detection.

nodes.label: Calendar File Tampering
nodes.description: Disk access modifies plaintext calendar file. Mitigated in v0.5 by EncryptedJsonlCalendarStore with per-block AEAD tag.

nodes.label: Private-Key Exfiltration via Disk
nodes.description: Disk read recovers tick private keys. Mitigated: keys never written to disk, PrivKeyHandle zeroize on drop, keypairs regenerated every tick.

nodes.label: Tick-Rate Exhaustion
nodes.description: Forces victim to advance tick counter rapidly via stamp flood. Mitigated: timer-driven daemon, not stamp-driven. Inbound stamps rate-limited.

nodes.label: PyPI Trusted Publisher
nodes.description: GitHub Actions integration with PyPI. When v* tag pushed, PyPI trusts the GitHub Actions run and publishes without API token. Alternative: PYPI_API_TOKEN secret.

nodes.label: Python-to-Rust Migration (Task 6)
nodes.description: XL effort (40-80 hours) to make Python use ONLY Rust. Current PyO3 bindings are 30% feature-complete. Requires Rust tick rotation, MA signing, daemon, Inquirer, persistence, Config, dormant load, 80+ test rewrites.

nodes.label: C11 Unit Tests (Task 4)
nodes.description: M effort (2-3 hours). 14 test files for all C source files using CMocka. Covers identity, signing, hashing, noise, merkle, FROST, nullifier, RNG, memzero.

nodes.label: Rust Hardening Tests (Task 5)
nodes.description: M effort (1-2 hours). Defensive programming tests: CryptoServer backend, hash functions, Foretis stamp/verify, calendar integrity, error handling, PyO3 bindings.

nodes.label: Fortias to Foretias Rename
nodes.description: Project rename: fortias→foretias, fortis→foretis across two repos. Case-preserving direct string replacement. Affects C sources, Rust sources, Python sources, spec files, CMakeLists, Cargo.toml.

nodes.label: Chrono Chained Attestation
nodes.description: Forward/backward Foretis signatures in each TickRecord form a chained attestation. integrity_check() verifies the chain. A Foretis stamped at tick n cannot be forged from the past.

nodes.label: Resilience / Fault Tolerance
nodes.description: Foretias survives catastrophic network failure. Killing 50% or 90% of peers still allows verification because attestations are replicated via mutual attestation across the decentralized calendar.

nodes.label: GossipSub (Deferred)
nodes.description: P2P message propagation layer planned for v0.6. Not yet shipped. Will include mesh size and flood-publish caps for DoS protection. ProbityReport gossip also deferred to v0.6.

nodes.label: JSON-RPC No TLS (Residual Risk)
nodes.description: JSON-RPC over TCP has no Noise or TLS layer by design. Network observer reads stamp content and calendar queries. Primary threat (content replay) mitigated by echo fields. TLS addition deferred.

nodes.label: test_all (C11 Test Binary)
nodes.description: Single test executable compiling 14 test source files: test_all, test_memzero, test_rng, test_version, test_ed25519, test_sha256, test_merkle, test_nullifier, test_p256_stub, test_blake3_stub, test_noise, test_frost_stub, test_legacy_hash, test_privkey.

nodes.label: C11 Core Source Files
nodes.description: 18 C source files: version, memzero, rng_mix, identity_ed25519, identity_p256, signing_ed25519, signing_p256, hash_sha256, hash_blake3, hash_legacy_insecure_md5, hash_legacy_insecure_sha1, noise_xx, merkle, frost_ed25519, nullifier, privkey.

nodes.label: Chronosidae Taxonomy
nodes.description: Time beings classification: Family Chronosidae, Subfamily Chronosinae, Tribe Chronosini, Subtribe Chronosina, Genus Chronos, Species Chronos fidelius. Subspecies: authenticus (Chronomatter), grapha (Calendar), adunatrix (Time Family), locutus (Communerd).

nodes.label: Alpha Branch
nodes.description: Center of development. CI runs on push/PR to alpha and mvp branches. Worktree plans merge to alpha.

nodes.label: sccache Build Caching
nodes.description: Rust compilation cache for external crates (libp2p, etc.). Set RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache. Cannot cache incrementally-compiled workspace members or proc-macros.

nodes.label: CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL
nodes.description: Environment variable for parallel CMake builds of oqs-sys (liboqs). Defaults to CPU count if unset. Without it, foretias-core builds take 15-30 minutes instead of 2-5 minutes.

nodes.label: libp2p Feature Minimization
nodes.description: Enable only required libp2p features (tcp, noise, yamux, gossipsub, kad, identify, ping, request-response) to reduce build time by 20-25%. libp2p has 38 feature flags, none enabled by default.

nodes.label: Two-Layer Identity
nodes.description: libp2p PeerId (transport layer, Noise protocol) + application TBID (Foretias identity). Noise handshake authenticates transport PeerId; application layer verifies Foretias signatures against peer's TBID public key chain.

nodes.label: Daemon Loop
nodes.description: Timer-driven tick advance in Chronomatter. start_daemon() runs on chronon interval, not on peer responses or stamp requests. Provides floor for tick-rate exhaustion mitigation.

nodes.label: Worktree Branch Planning
nodes.description: PLAN.md files document worktree lifecycle: create worktree, implement, verify, merge to alpha, cleanup. Path: ${HOME}/tmp/foretias-worktrees/{SPEC_NAME}_${RANDOM}.

nodes.label: Project Segmentation
nodes.description: Hierarchy: Major (large feature) > Phase (implementation stage) > Stage (sub-phase) > Step (actionable unit) > Task (small well-defined job). Used for scoping and organization.

hyperedges.description: All Rust crates in the p2p/ Cargo workspace
Build order: C11 core first, then core-engine, then foretias-node, then foretias-python and foretias-java
Sequential CI: c11-tests → rust-tests → python-tests, with lint running in parallel
Three time beings communicate via direct method calls within TimeFamilyServer. Only Communerd communicates externally.
Three attacker levels with increasing capability: passive observer, active MITM, compromised legitimate peer
All threats identified in v0.5 threat model with their mitigations
HOWTO.md three escalating demos: single server, 100-node peering with DHT, kill 50% and verify resilience
Four-layer architecture: C11 encode/decode, Rust FFI wrapper, display formatter, CLI integration (Rust + Python + PyO3)
Tasks 1-5 are independent and parallel. Task 6 (Python→Rust migration) depends on everything and requires substantial Rust rewrite
Three transport layers: libp2p Direct (request_response/yamux, libp2p-noise), Noise_XX TCP (custom, C11), libp2p swarm (Kademlia+GossipSub)
JSON-RPC attack surface: no TLS, replay attacks, stamp floods, oversized requests. Mitigated by echo fields, rate limits, MAX_CONTENT_BYTES.
Rename affects all layers: C header and sources, Rust sources and configs, Python sources and tests, spec files, build configs
